entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a preference and fit issue. They're a great pair of shoes, but they're giving me terrible blisters on any ride over an hour. I've tried adjusting the cleats every way I can think of, but the fit just isn't right for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Level Cycling Shoes, delivered 68 days ago. Let me just check the policy. Yes, you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. I can process a full refund for you.

That's fantastic. I appreciate that. Now, since I'll be ordering a different pair from you and I've been a VeloFit customer for years, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Just to help offset the inconvenience.

That's a reasonable request. Let me check your account status... Ah, yes, I see you're a VIP member with us. Absolutely. As a thank you for your loyalty, I'd be happy to add a 15% discount coupon to your account for your next order. You can use it to find the perfect pair that won't cause any blisters.
A 15% discount is perfect. Thank you, David, you've been very helpful. I was hoping for a positive resolution like this.

You're most welcome. I'm glad we could sort this out. I've just emailed you the prepaid return label. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be issued. The discount code is already active on your account. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
